system.description: Launch an explosive sphere of fire magic at a target location. All units within and adjacent to the point of impact must succeed an Agi Saving Throw (DC = 8 + Caster Wit), or else take 4d6 + Wit Fire damage and 3 Brk. On a successful save, units are only dealt 4d6 Fire damage and no Brk damage.
You gather the stormclouds in the skies to rain down elemental fury upon a foe. This spell has extremely long range and ignores LoS.

Frigid air sails around your target, dealing massive Brk damage. If this attack puts your target into Stance Break, or if it hits a Stance Broken unit, the target is Frozen for 1 turn. A Frozen unit cannot move, take any action, or recover from Stance Break at the end of their turn.

Gain 1 additional use of this spell for each Elemental Proficiency rank above C.

Send a sphere of electric energy to detonate upon impact with a target. A highly volatile spell with a high chance for critical hits. 

Cannot make Extra Attacks.

A mundane, but nevertheless potent and reliable offensive spell for the common mage.

Gain 1 additional use of this spell per unit Level.

Bolster your defenses with magic, gaining up to 10 Shield points. This spell will not increase your Shield past 10 points. (Shield points are temporary HP that absorb damage dealt to the unit. If all damage from an attack or effect is absorbed, any Stance damage that would normally accompany the attack or effect is negated.)

Teleport to another square within range of this spell. The Range of this spell scales with the caster's Wit (up to a maximum of 6 Rng at 25 Wit).

 Gain an additional use of this spell at S-rank in Arcane Proficiency.
Increases the Wit of its wearer by +1
